passages.note: Vote page shows Stern among the Ayes on SB 100's final concurrence vote, 25-13.

passages.provision_quote: the quantities shall reflect reasonable progress in each of the intervening years sufficient to ensure that the procurement of electricity products from eligible renewable energy resources achieves 25 percent of retail sales by December 31, 2016, 33 percent by December 31, 2020, 44 percent by December 31, 2024, 52 percent by December 31, 2027, and 60 percent by December 31, 2030
passages.note: Bill text sets binding, dated RPS percentages matching rung 1's mandate-with-firm-deadline language; the 2045 100% clean policy clause is a goal and does not cancel this binding clause.

rows.reasoning: Senator Stern voted Aye on SB 100 (2017-2018), which requires retail sellers to procure eligible renewable energy resources so that procurement 'achieves 25 percent of retail sales by December 31, 2016, 33 percent by December 31, 2020, 44 percent by December 31, 2024, 52 percent by December 31, 2027, and 60 percent by December 31, 2030' — a binding requirement with firm deadlines matching 'Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines.' The bill's separate 2045 'policy of the state' language is a stated goal and does not displace this binding clause.
